{{Quote|You don't fancy the new red armor, then?"''<br />''"I'd look a complete idiot in it. No, the Imperial Guard can do without me. I'd never fit in the suit now. Besides, the Emperor wants fit and dedicated young stormtroopers to do the job, and I'm an old street cop at heart.|Imperial Commando [[Niner Skirata]] and Captain [[Jaller Obrim]]|<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
'''Coruscant Guard armor''' was a specialized [[Armor/Legends|armor]] issued only to members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] during the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Over a hundred years later, the [[1,001st stormtrooper division|Knighthunters]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] division of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] wore armor based on that of the Coruscant Guard.

==Description==
{{Quote|Their faces are covered, and since they are so well regarded, nobody is apt to bother them.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] discussing the Coruscant Guard|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
The armor was light, yet heavily padded,<ref name="SES" /> and crimson and black in color.<ref name="CSWEcoreguards" /> It was designed to provide protection against physical attacks. Their sophisticated battle helmet was lined with advanced sensors, allowed them to work in complete darkness, and also contained a [[Comm unit scrambler|comlink scrambler]] for communication with fellow personnel. A unit commander's helmet was also equipped with a voice activated heads-up display that showed Coruscant Guard positions. Optional tracking beacon software let a unit commander know the whereabouts of his subordinates at all times. This display system also provided a useful method of navigating the complex city structure of Imperial Center.<ref name="SES" />
==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GuardLuke.jpg|thumb|Concept art of Luke wearing a Coruscant Guard helmet for the Kenner action figure.]]
The Coruscant Guard corps was invented for the ''[[Shadows of the Empire]]'' multimedia project. In a scene of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|novelization]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] disable two guards to disguise with their armor.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)" /> However this scene is absent from the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic book]] and the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|video game]] adaptations.<ref>[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' comic series]]</ref><ref>[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> In an apparent continuity error, the card #53 of the [[1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|1996 Topps ''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'']] series, shows Luke and Lando hiding in the [[Southern Underground/Legends|Southern Underground]] with their regular attires.<ref name="Card-Topps-Dash Does it Again">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Dash Does it Again|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC053.jpg}}</ref> The only appearance of the disguise is a figure of Luke in an "elite Coruscant stormtrooper" armor released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]]<ref>{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Luke Skywalker (In Imperial Guard Disguise)|link=soteKluke.asp}} {{C|as elite Coruscant stormtroopers}}</ref> as part of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|''Shadows of the Empire'' toy line]]. 

Some appearances of the ''Shadows of the Empire'' line suggest that the elite Guards served also Xizor, or that Xizor's private army wore similar armor. Topps card #66 shows Coruscant Guards stationed on the [[Falleen's Fist]]<ref name="Card-Topps-Battle Over Coruscant: Part I">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Battle Over Coruscant: Part I|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC066.jpg}}</ref> whereas the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|comic book adaptation]] shows Xizor's Palace defended by red-armored Guards.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire 6">[[Shadows of the Empire 6|''Shadows of the Empire'' 6]]</ref>
